run.question:
The checkout-service in production-eu-west-2 is throwing 500s. Please look at
app-264-prod-logs and find the root cause.

report.summary: No data exists for the cluster named in the question. The index app-264-prod-logs is the only Elasticsearch index present and holds exactly three documents in the authorized window (2026-10-24T17:39:58Z to 2026-11-23T17:39:58Z); all three carry cluster=staging-eu-west-2, environment=staging, region=eu-west-2, and none carries production-eu-west-2. So the production-eu-west-2 checkout-service logs the question asks for are absent from this source, and nothing drawn from this index can be used as the root cause of a production-eu-west-2 incident. What the three staging documents say: two checkout-service ERROR lines, one at 2026-11-23T15:39:51Z ("Smoke test failed: deploy-v2.3.4 rollback in progress") and one at 2026-11-23T16:39:51Z ("POST /api/checkout returned 500: integration-test fixture stripe-test-key expired"), plus a payment-service WARN at 2026-11-23T17:09:51Z ("Using mock provider for staging (stripe-mock)"). The only cluster readable with Kubernetes is staging-eu-west-2 (namespace otel-demo), and there checkout is not failing: pod checkout-6578865d87-v6flf is ready with 0 restarts and its 200 newest log lines (17:03:34Z to 17:39:29Z) are successful PlaceOrder, "payment went through", and confirmation-email entries; payment-6f7bc865d6-wwqnm logs only "Charge request received" and "Transaction complete" (17:11:56Z to 17:39:29Z). Deployment checkout is at revision 1 with a single ReplicaSet created 14:36:30Z and image demo:2.0.2-checkout, so no rollout or rollback is visible in this cluster, and every fault-injection flag in ConfigMap flagd-config still has defaultVariant "off". Prometheus and Jaeger were unreachable in this Run, so error-rate, latency, and error-span evidence could not be checked in any cluster, and the change-history integration is not available. The cause of production-eu-west-2 checkout 500s therefore cannot be determined from the available sources.

No document names production-eu-west-2.

The only checkout-service ERROR documents are staging-eu-west-2 records: at 2026-11-23T15:39:51Z message "Smoke test failed: deploy-v2.3.4 rollback in progress", and at 2026-11-23T16:39:51Z message "POST /api/checkout returned 500: integration-test fixture stripe-test-key expired" (cluster staging-eu-west-2, environment staging, service checkout-service, level ERROR).
The third document is a payment-service WARN at 2026-11-23T17:09:51Z with message "Using mock provider for staging (stripe-mock)" and cluster staging-eu-west-2, environment staging.

In the staging-eu-west-2 cluster (namespace otel-demo) pod checkout-6578865d87-v6flf is Running and ready with restartCount 0 and startTime 2026-11-23T14:36:30Z; its 200 newest log lines, covering 2026-11-23T17:03:34Z to 2026-11-23T17:39:29Z, are successful PlaceOrder, "payment went through (transaction_id: ...)" and "order confirmation email sent to ..." entries with no error text shown.

In the same staging cluster pod payment-6f7bc865d6-wwqnm logs only successful charge handling: "Charge request received." followed by "Transaction complete." with transactionId, covering 2026-11-23T17:11:56Z to 2026-11-23T17:39:29Z in the 100 lines shown.

Deployment checkout in namespace otel-demo is at deployment.kubernetes.io/revision "1", created 2026-11-23T14:36:29Z, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.0.2-checkout, with PAYMENT_ADDR=payment:8080 and FLAGD_HOST=flagd; its only ReplicaSet checkout-6578865d87 (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.0.2-checkout) was created 2026-11-23T14:36:30Z and is owned by Deployment checkout. No second ReplicaSet or newer revision indicating a rollout or rollback is present.

ConfigMap flagd-config in namespace otel-demo holds demo.flagd.json in which the fault flags paymentFailure ("Fail payment service charge requests n%"), paymentUnreachable ("Payment service is unavailable"), productCatalogFailure, cartFailure, adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, recommendationCacheFailure, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage and imageSlowLoad all declare "state": "ENABLED" but "defaultVariant": "off" (the off variant being 0 or false).

Flag-based fault injection in flagd-config caused checkout 500s was considered and rejected for the staging-eu-west-2 cluster: every fault flag that targets payment/checkout (paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable) and the other services has defaultVariant "off", and no flag-driven error appears in the checkout or payment pod logs.

The two checkout-service ERROR lines were considered as the incident record and rejected as evidence of production-eu-west-2 impact: both documents carry cluster="staging-eu-west-2" and environment="staging", and their own text attributes the failure to a smoke test ("Smoke test failed: deploy-v2.3.4 rollback in progress") and to an integration-test fixture ("integration-test fixture stripe-test-key expired"); no rollout or rollback exists on Deployment checkout in the staging cluster (revision 1, single ReplicaSet).

Against a live checkout failure in staging-eu-west-2: the checkout pod is ready with 0 restarts and its newest 200 log lines show completed orders with successful payment transactions and confirmation emails up to 2026-11-23T17:39:29Z, while the payment pod shows only successful charge completions in the same period.

If production-eu-west-2 checkout 500s are real, the staging ERROR text points at a credential or fixture cause ("stripe-test-key expired") in checkout's payment path, but this remains unverified for production: no production-eu-west-2 document, metric or trace was retrievable, and secret values cannot be read.

gaps: No document in app-264-prod-logs carries cluster=production-eu-west-2 or environment=production; the index returns only 3 staging-eu-west-2/staging documents, so the production-eu-west-2 checkout-service logs the question asks for are not present in this log source (index listing shows app-264-prod-logs is the only index).

Prometheus was unreachable in this Run: get_all_labels, get_metric_names and get_label_values each returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so checkout error rate and latency (e.g. traces_span_metrics_calls_total, rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket, rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count) and any ERROR series could not be checked in any cluster.

Jaeger was unreachable in this Run: traces_list_services and traces_search for service checkout returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so error spans and any checkout-to-payment call edge could not be verified.

The all-namespaces events query returned no rows (view status no_data, total_items_processed 0), so the claimed 'deploy-v2.3.4 rollback' cannot be confirmed or dated from events, and rollout/restart history is unknown.

The checkout log view 698e0407-fb2e-472e-af25-03a71b8d211e-t0:7e20409a-5f77-4037-956a-49dc738a6f3c is marked incomplete (newest 200 of 300 matching lines shown), so container output around 2026-11-23T15:39:51Z and 16:39:51Z was not read; the payment log view 67a51135-9e80-4fbe-89de-16c1160dbf3c-t1:47a1b3a4-dc17-4dd2-8591-78fbeb181bd1 is likewise incomplete (newest 100 of 200 lines shown). Both pods report no previous container instance to inspect.

The keyword query on the checkout pod logs for err|error|fail|500|exception|panic returned no matching lines (view status no_data, 300 lines read, all filtered out); this shows only that this query matched nothing in the lines read, not that no error was logged.
Whether the 'stripe-test-key' expiration reflects a real credential problem cannot be verified: Kubernetes secrets cannot be read in this Run.
The change_history integration is listed as not integrated, so no deployment or configuration change record is available to explain any restart or behavior change during the window.
No production-eu-west-2 cluster could be inspected with the Kubernetes tools, which read only the cluster staging-eu-west-2 (namespace otel-demo); the state of production workloads is unknown.
next_steps: Point the log search at the production-eu-west-2 log index or stream (or fix the shipping labels for app-264-prod-logs) and re-run the same timeframe query there.
Once Prometheus and Jaeger are reachable, compare checkout's error rate and p95 latency against a pre-incident baseline and inspect error spans for the failing checkout operation.
If a 'deploy-v2.3.4 rollback' really happened, obtain the change or deployment record from the change-history integration and correlate it with the first 500 in production.
Check whether the payment credential used by checkout in production has expired, without relying on the staging 'stripe-test-key' text.

view.cannot_prove: Objects are the cluster's state when the query ran, not during the incident window: they cannot prove what was true earlier, and an object missing now may have existed then. Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind. When the API server returns zero objects of a kind other than events (every page read), the result is ok with total_items_processed 0: it proves only that there were no objects matching this kind, namespace and selectors at query time, not that none existed during the incident. Zero events, or a list your filter reduced to nothing, stays no_data. metadata.managedFieldsSummary gives each manager's last write time only: it is not a full change history (earlier writes by the same manager are gone) and it does not say which fields that write changed.
